import math
def solve():
    n=int(input())
    pts=[tuple(map(int,input().split()))for _ in range(n)]
    if n==1:print(1);return
    best=2
    for i in range(n):
        slope=dict()
        for j in range(n):
            if i==j:continue
            dx=pts[j][0]-pts[i][0];dy=pts[j][1]-pts[i][1]
            g=math.gcd(abs(dx),abs(dy));dx//=g;dy//=g
            if dx<0:dx,dy=-dx,-dy
            elif dx==0 and dy<0:dy=-dy
            slope[(dx,dy)]=slope.get((dx,dy),0)+1
        if slope:best=max(best,max(slope.values())+1)
    print(best)
solve()

def solve(n,pts):
    pts=[tuple(p)for p in pts]
    if n==1:return 1
    best=2
    for i in range(n):
        slope=dict()
        for j in range(n):
            if i==j:continue
            dx=pts[j][0]-pts[i][0];dy=pts[j][1]-pts[i][1]
            g=math.gcd(abs(dx),abs(dy));dx//=g;dy//=g
            if dx<0:dx,dy=-dx,-dy
            elif dx==0 and dy<0:dy=-dy
            slope[(dx,dy)]=slope.get((dx,dy),0)+1
        if slope:best=max(best,max(slope.values())+1)
    return best
